templates.description_en: Ink Bleed - black ink blooms into the outgoing scene like a brush painting, the ink bleeding across the frame and dissolving into the incoming scene with ink-wash strokes
templates.prompt:
A seamless Ink Bleed transition effect between two scenes.

integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] [0-3s] The first scene holds steady in a cinematic composition. The frame is stable, the lighting is balanced, and the subject is clearly visible, establishing the visual context that will be transformed by the transition.
[Shot 2] [3-6s] Black ink blooms into the outgoing scene like a brush painting, the ink bleeding across the frame and dissolving into the incoming scene with ink-wash strokes. The transition executes with fluid, natural motion and cinematic quality. The camera movement and visual effect remain smooth and continuous, completing the handoff from the first scene to the second scene seamlessly.

overall_soundscape: ink drops with wet brush strokes on paper. No dialogue, no music in the soundscape layer.

non_diegetic_music: a traditional guzheng melody with bamboo flute, synced to the rhythm of the transition for a polished editorial feel.
